transcript.statement: Trustworthiness is paramount for a library management system, ensuring that only authenticated members can borrow or return books (TRU-01) and that all transactions are logged for auditability (TRU-02). Protecting member personal data through encryption (TRU-03) and implementing role-based access control (TRU-04) enhances security. Additionally, securely managing overdue books (TRU-05) and allowing members to update their information (TRU-06) are essential for privacy. Strong password policies (TRU-07) further safeguard accounts against unauthorized access. These requirements collectively ensure a secure and trustworthy environment for all users.

transcript.statement: The library management system must prioritize ethical and compliance standards to ensure accountability and fairness for all users. requirements.text: The library management system shall ensure a maximum of 5 simultaneous book borrows per member to maintain safety and resource management.
The library management system shall allow for exceptions to the 5-book borrowing limit with documented justification to ensure transparency.
The library management system shall merge overdue notifications into a single process that notifies members within 24 hours of the due date.
The library management system shall track energy usage for borrowing activities to promote sustainability.
The library management system shall implement energy-efficient servers to minimize environmental impact.
The library management system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, promoting fairness and inclusivity.
The library management system shall log all borrowing transactions for auditability.
The library management system shall enforce data encryption for all member personal information stored.
The library management system shall implement role-based access control for librarians and members.
The library management system shall maintain an uptime of 99.5% to ensure consistent availability.
